issues.description: The CAD layout shows 14 modules, but the BOM specifies 10. Rail, clamp, attachment and electrical quantities cannot be released until the build configuration is reconciled.
issues.fix: Choose the approved module layout, then regenerate the BOM and installation drawings from it.
issues.rule_citation: Installation documentation must identify the installed PV array configuration — IEC 62446-1.

issues.description: Roof type, structure, wind and snow loads, attachment spacing and waterproofing detail are unspecified. A factory cannot select compatible hooks or feet or validate the roof penetrations.
issues.fix: Provide a site survey and structural load assessment; specify the roof-compatible attachment schedule and flashing detail before procurement.
issues.rule_citation: PV array mechanical design must account for site conditions and mounting loads — IEC 62548.

issues.description: The inverter, isolator, cable and connectors are described generically, without a string diagram or verified electrical ratings. The proposed components cannot be checked against the selected modules.
issues.fix: Issue a string and wiring diagram with module and inverter datasheets, cold-condition string voltage, operating current, cable sizing and specified compatible connectors and disconnect ratings.
issues.rule_citation: PV array electrical design and component selection must account for maximum voltage and current — IEC 62548.

issues.description: Solid product (424.3 L of material): not an injection-moulded shell, so draft, undercut, wall thickness and clamp tonnage do not apply. Process: on-site installation of bought-in modules, rails and inverter.
issues.fix: Quote the listed process; send the STEP as the shaping / routing / layout file.
issues.rule_citation: Moulded-shell DFM rules apply to injection moulding only (Protolabs design guide)

issues.description: 14 modules on the layout (projected module area ≈ 21.4 m²): standard 1722 × 1134 mm class, bought in.
issues.fix: Keep the 45 cm roof-edge margin; check rafter spacing against the roof-hook pitch on site.
issues.rule_citation: Installer practice: edge margins for wind uplift zones (EN 1991-1-4) — Estimate

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Modules counted in the layout CAD, measured on the product CAD (build123d/OCCT)

issues.fix: Survey the roof (area, orientation, shading) before ordering.
issues.rule_citation: Site survey before PV design — installer practice

issues.description: “Per module datasheet” is not a rail or clamp manufacturing tolerance, and the anodised finish is not specified at mating interfaces.
issues.fix: Add controlled rail-section and clamp-interface dimensions, extrusion tolerances, anodising requirements and a fit check against the selected module frame.
issues.rule_citation: Extruded aluminium profile dimensional tolerances — EN 755-9.

issues.description: Solid product (424.3 L of material): not an injection-moulded shell, so draft, undercut, wall thickness and clamp tonnage do not apply. Process: on-site installation of bought-in modules, rails and inverter.
issues.fix: Quote the listed process; send the STEP as the shaping / routing / layout file.
issues.rule_citation: Moulded-shell DFM rules apply to injection moulding only (Protolabs design guide)

issues.description: 14 modules on the layout (projected module area ≈ 21.4 m²): standard 1722 × 1134 mm class, bought in.
issues.fix: Keep the 45 cm roof-edge margin; check rafter spacing against the roof-hook pitch on site.
issues.rule_citation: Installer practice: edge margins for wind uplift zones (EN 1991-1-4) — Estimate

measurement.label: measured

issues.fix: Survey the roof (area, orientation, shading) before ordering.
issues.rule_citation: Site survey before PV design — installer practice

issues.description: The module BOM quantity is 10, but the CAD layout contains 14 modules. Rail, clamp, attachment and electrical quantities cannot be released against conflicting counts.
issues.fix: Reconcile the BOM and layout, then recalculate mounting hardware and electrical quantities.
issues.rule_citation: BOM quantities must match the released installation layout — DFM assembly verification.

issues.description: Rail alignment and module-gap tolerances are given without a datum or an adjustment method for roof and module variation.
issues.fix: Define layout datums, rail-slot adjustment range and an installation inspection method.
issues.rule_citation: Dimensions and tolerances require defined datums for verification — ISO 1101.

issues.description: The approximate module and inverter ratings do not define a buildable string: module voltage, temperature limits, MPPT range and DC isolator ratings remain unverified.
issues.fix: Select exact module and inverter models; issue a string diagram and verify worst-case voltage, current and isolator ratings.
issues.rule_citation: PV array electrical design must verify equipment and circuit ratings — IEC 62548.

issues.description: The battery inverter/charger is specified as compatible with the existing grid-tie system, but its connection topology, protection and control interface are undefined.
issues.fix: Specify an approved battery and inverter pairing, single-line diagram, protection scheme and commissioning procedure.
issues.rule_citation: Electrical energy storage systems require coordinated system design and installation — IEC 62933-5-2.

issues.description: The battery pack has no stated cell chemistry, installation location, enclosure rating, ventilation or separation from heat sources; safe placement cannot be checked.
issues.fix: Select a certified battery pack and document its permitted mounting location, environmental limits and manufacturer-required clearances.
issues.rule_citation: Safety requirements for stationary lithium batteries — IEC 62619; electrical energy storage system safety — IEC 62933-5-2.

assembly_notes: Fit rails and clamps to the roof structure and verify alignment and module-specific mounting requirements.
Mount modules using the specified clamp zones and torque limits; protect glass edges and avoid twisting frames.
Install the inverter, DC isolator, AC protection, and PV-rated cabling per electrical and local code requirements.
Verify polarity, connector compatibility, protective earthing, insulation, and string voltage before energizing.
Function-test inverter startup, MPPT operation, isolation, and AC protection; no battery handling or shipping constraints apply.
